tools.name: repair_json
tools.description: Universal LLM JSON repair and syntax sanitizer. Fixes malformed JSON (code blocks, single quotes, trailing commas, Python literals) into RFC 8259 format in <1ms.

raw_json.description: Malformed or broken JSON string to repair.

tools.name: unwrap_markdown
tools.description: Strips markdown code fences (```json, ```python, etc.) and conversational preamble from LLM outputs to isolate clean payloads.

text.description: Raw LLM output text containing markdown code fences.

tools.name: validate_json_schema
tools.description: Deterministic AST schema validator checking presence and basic types of required keys with zero token cost.

tools.name: repair_csv
tools.description: Normalizes and repairs malformed CSV text (inconsistent delimiters, ragged rows, unescaped quotes) into RFC 4180 format.

raw_csv.description: Raw unformatted or malformed CSV string.

tools.name: diff_ast_keys
tools.description: Compares key structures between source and target dictionaries, reporting missing, extra, and common keys.

tools.name: extract_markdown
tools.description: Web-to-Markdown context compressor. Scrapes web URLs or parses raw HTML into clean, token-efficient Markdown, saving 80-95% context tokens.

url.description: Public URL to fetch and convert to Markdown.

html.description: Raw HTML string to parse directly.

tools.name: distill_context
tools.description: Compresses long articles or documents into dense structured bullet takeaways, key metrics, and top keywords.

raw_text.description: Raw article or document text to distill.

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Parses markdown or HTML tables into structured JSON lists of records.

text.description: Text or HTML containing tabular data.

tools.name: strip_boilerplate
tools.description: Strips cookie notices, legal disclaimers, navigation bars, and social share boilerplate from documents.

tools.name: score_readability
tools.description: Computes text metrics, token density, and Flesch Reading Ease score for automated content grading.

tools.name: sanitize_pii
tools.description: Zero-latency privacy and PII sanitizer. Redacts emails, phone numbers, payment cards, and SSNs before data leaves trust boundaries.

text.description: Raw text string to scan and redact PII from.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: B2B email and deliverability verifier. Validates RFC 5322 syntax, performs live DNS MX lookup, and detects disposable/burner domains.

check_mx.description: Verify live DNS MX records (default: true).

tools.name: validate_hash
tools.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 integrity validator. Computes and checks payload digests against expected hashes.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON payload or dictionary to hash.

tools.name: scan_prompt_injection
tools.description: Fast regex heuristic scanner detecting prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and system prompt override patterns.

prompt.description: Prompt text to inspect for injection patterns.

tools.name: detect_entropy
tools.description: Calculates Shannon entropy to detect exposed credentials, API keys, and cryptographic secrets in text.

text.description: Text or token string to scan for high-entropy secrets.

tools.name: get_market_quote
tools.description: Real-time multi-asset market spot price oracle for crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP) and equities with 30s TTL edge cache.

nocache.description: Bypass edge cache for fresh query.

tools.name: scan_market_delta
tools.description: Calculates statistical delta, spread, and discrepancy between two series or asset prices for arbitrage detection.

tools.name: get_crypto_ticker
tools.description: Multi-currency crypto price ticker and exchange conversion rates (BTC, ETH, SOL to GBP/USD/EUR).

tools.name: estimate_gas_priority
tools.description: Real-time fee priority estimations for Bitcoin (sat/vB: fast, half_hour, hour) and Ethereum (gwei: rapid, fast, standard).

tools.name: check_market_volatility
tools.description: Calculates statistical volatility metrics (standard deviation, annualized volatility, price span) across price points.

symbol.description: Asset ticker to generate volatility from if series is omitted.

tools.name: mint_bolt11_invoice
tools.description: Mints real BOLT-11 Lightning invoices via Alby Hub Lightning node (:8029) for autonomous machine payments.

tools.name: verify_payment_hash
tools.description: Verifies settlement status of a Lightning invoice or payment hash via Alby Hub node.

tools.name: relay_signed_webhook
tools.description: Outbound webhook dispatcher with HMAC-SHA256 signature, latency metering, and delivery receipts.

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Edge IP and network taxonomy lookup. Resolves IP routing taxonomy, private/loopback CIDRs, and reverse DNS PTR.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address string to inspect.

tools.name: ping_health_probe
tools.description: Edge hardware telemetry, load averages, uptime, and sub-millisecond heartbeat verification.
